observations.detail: The instance requires productID and the compatibility field product.
The instance requires visions; the CLI defaults it to rnd.
The instance requires reviewer for requirement.change and account for user.edit.
The instance accepts classification strings as well as numeric IDs.
The instance requires the documented compatibility fields and status/date preservation described in the acceptance record.
The target returned empty responses or reported an unavailable module; the implementation reports an API error instead of treating the response as success.
